terra.problem: Saying Joshua and Caleb had only said the land was exceedingly good leaves out their other words, including their call not to rebel or fear the people of the land (Numbers 14:8–9).

The claim that nobody in the camp is throwing a rejoicing party adds a detail the text does not give. The passage says the people wept that night, but does not describe everyone’s actions when the LORD speaks to Moses.
